findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: otto_equity_intel, otto_delegation_cap · Private data: otto_tokenized_equities, otto_rh_season, otto_base_season, otto_stock_pools, otto_prepare_bridge, otto_prepare_polymarket_order, otto_prepare_perp_order, otto_prepare_yield_deposit, otto_prepare_yield_withdraw, otto_prepare_stock_buy, otto_submit_under_delegation, otto_delegation_fence, otto_delegation_status, otto_delegation_revoke, otto_delegation_cap, otto_delegation_operations, otto_delegation_reconcile, otto_delegation_exit, otto_x_recipes · Public sink: otto_prepare_yield_deposit, otto_prepare_yield_withdraw, otto_prepare_stock_buy, otto_submit_under_delegation, otto_delegation_fence_status, otto_delegation_fence, otto_delegation_status, otto_delegation_cap, otto_delegation_exit · Destructive: otto_prepare_swap, otto_prepare_bridge, otto_submit_under_delegation, otto_delegation_fence_status, otto_delegation_cap.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
